ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Action Construction Equipment Limited (ACE) has scheduled its 32nd Annual General Meeting for September 18, 2026, to be held virtually. The key material impact for shareholders is the September 03, 2026 record date, determining eligibility for the final dividend if declared at the AGM. This document outlines standard corporate governance procedures for the AGM, dividend distribution, e-voting, and book closure, presenting no red flags.
